qa_pairs.question: How has the Passenger Baggage Allowance for baggage brought by land-route passengers evolved regarding monetary thresholds and frequency limitations according to the provided regulations?
qa_pairs.answer: The monetary threshold for baggage imported by land-route passengers was initially set at 300 USD (clauses [0], [1], [2]) and later increased to 400 USD (clauses [3], [4], [5], [6], [7], [8]). Additionally, starting from 2023, a frequency limitation was introduced, restricting passengers from receiving this duty-free baggage allowance more than 3 times per calendar year (clauses [5], [6], [7], [8]).
